lines: Bump SemVer + chore(release) commit + local tag (no push)

card.summary: Standalone SemVer bump: reads package.json, infers a conservative level from the commit subject, writes a separate chore(release) commit, tags locally. No push.
card.paragraph: The standalone counterpart to /stx-pr-merge's built-in bump step. Use when you forgot to bump in the last shipped PR, want to override the auto-inference, or are aggregating several feature PRs into a single release commit. Strictly local — push is intentionally left to /stx-pr-merge or a hand-run git push --follow-tags.
use_when: Last PR shipped without a bump — make a release commit now
Auto picked patch for a feat:, want to bump minor instead
Release-PR style: aggregate several merged PRs into one chore(release)
Using /stx-checkin (no /stx-pr-merge) and want the bump artifact locally
dontuse_when: You're running /stx-pr-merge — its STEP 1b already does this
Working tree is dirty — release commit must be bump-only
You want to push the tag — use /stx-pr-merge or git push --follow-tags

invocations.comment: auto-infer level from HEAD commit subject
infer from a non-HEAD commit (e.g. release-PR aggregation)
non-Node repo using a plain VERSION file

extras.title: minor / major are explicit-only
extras.html: The auto-policy never infers minor or major on its own — those require an explicit positional minor/major or --bump minor/--bump major. !/BREAKING CHANGE: markers are the one exception (they signal major deliberately).
Tag is created locally only. Push when you ship — /stx-pr-merge does this automatically at STEP 5b, or run git push origin vX.Y.Z by hand.
